statement: Pinned BN254 R1CS suite: 26 scoped instances, 73 implementation cases. Arithmetic factoring/fusion reduces 192 to 64 rows for 64 expressions; published range encoding plus witness elimination reduces x<13 from 10 to 4; range-only 64-bit predicate reduces 65 to 64 rows with unchanged multiplication count; field-valued depth-8 Merkle ordering reduces 2182 to 2174. Known-technique implementations, not global optima or novelty claims.
status: Local pilot; author-checked candidate records; not accepted by an independent reviewer or maintainer
scope: BN254 scalar Fr; finalized total R1CS rows; arkworks 0.5 series locked. Full interfaces/hash/proving assumptions in FORMULATION.md. Custom symbolic checker covers optimized candidates; ten upstream comparator/full-field baseline cases have only numerical checks. Timing exploratory on busy shared hardware.

assumptions.statement: Custom exact-algebra Python checker has mutation tests but no independent review or proof-assistant formalization.
Circuit relation uses fixed benchmark Poseidon parameters. Cryptographic hash security and Groth16 setup assumptions are not proven here.
Full-field decomposition and constant comparator rely on upstream correctness; their complete relation proof is not implemented in our restricted checker.
One local contributor trial cannot establish continuing discovery yield, independent novelty, or review throughput.

prerequisites: Python 3.9+ (standard library only for saved-artifact checks)
Rust/Cargo and network on first full rebuild; pinned dependencies in Cargo.lock
